newsitem.title: USA: Hilton unmoved by ITT hotel deal.
newsitem.headline: Hilton unmoved by ITT hotel deal.

text.p: ITT Corp's addition of 28 new hotels is not likely to prompt a change in Hilton Hotels Corp's $6.5 billion bid for ITT, a Hilton spokesman said Thursday.
"I don't anticipate it would change the offer," Marc Grossman, Hilton's senior vice president-corporate affairs, told Reuters. "But obviously we don't know the financial details."

Depending on the quality of the 28 hotels, Hilton might welcome the deal, he said. "We've always said what is appealing to us is ITT's portfolio of good hotels. To the extent there are more good hotels in ITT's portfolio, that's great," Grossman said.

Earlier today ITT's ITT Sheraton unit unveiled an agreement to acquire a hotel in Monterrey, Mexico, for a $15 million equity investment, and said it had signed management and franchise contracts for 27 others around the world.
ITT said the deal would immediately accrete to earnings and would generate significant cash flow over the next 10 years.
Hilton's $55 per share bid for ITT is to expire February 28. ITT has rejected the offer.
